sensors.name: light sensor LLIGHT (the light from above, dim inside a tunnel)

control_flow: avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70 % (dim) and the LEFT sensor sees a wall, turn left 20°; else if the RIGHT sensor sees one, turn right 20°; else call driveInTheDark.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is not below 70 % (bright), call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 % without end; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if the FRONT sensor sees something, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.
